identity.name: Demo Vidya Mandir Senior Secondary School
identity.tagline: Learn with curiosity, lead with character

landing.about: Demo Vidya Mandir has taught the children of this district since 1994. We are a co-educational, English-medium school affiliated to the state board, teaching classes Nursery to XII across two shifts on a six-acre campus. Our class sizes are capped at thirty-five so that every child is known by name, and every teacher is expected to know how each of their students is doing, not just what the average is. Science and commerce streams are offered at the senior secondary level, alongside a humanities stream introduced in 2019.
landing.vision: To send out young people who think clearly, speak honestly and are useful to the community they live in.

principal.name: Dr. Anita Deshpande
principal.message: A school is not its building. It is the habits a child picks up between the morning bell and the evening bus, and the adults who model them. We keep our promises small and keep them: teachers who prepare, homework that gets read, parents who hear from us before a problem grows, and a classroom where a wrong answer is the start of a conversation rather than the end of one. You are welcome to visit us on any working day and see whether we live up to that.

academics.board: Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education
academics.summary: Teaching runs from Nursery to class XII in English medium, with science, commerce and humanities streams at the senior secondary level. Class sizes are capped at thirty-five, and every teacher keeps a weekly record of how each child is progressing rather than only what the class average was.

levels.name: Pre-primary
levels.description: Play-led learning, with phonics, number sense and a great deal of time outdoors.

levels.name: Primary
levels.description: Reading fluency, written expression and arithmetic, with art, music and games every week.

levels.name: Middle
levels.description: Subject teachers take over, laboratory work begins, and students choose a third language.

levels.name: Secondary
levels.description: Board preparation with weekly tests, remedial classes and one-to-one parent meetings each term.

levels.name: Senior secondary
levels.description: Science, commerce and humanities streams, with career counselling and entrance-exam coaching.

highlights.title: Thirty-two years in the district
highlights.description: Teaching the children, and now the grandchildren, of the families around us since 1994.

highlights.title: Thirty-five to a class
highlights.description: Small enough that every child is known by name and no one hides at the back.

highlights.title: Laboratories, not demonstrations
highlights.description: Physics, chemistry and biology practicals that students run themselves from class VI.

highlights.title: Parents hear from us early
highlights.description: A call before a problem grows, not a report card after it has.

highlights.title: Sport for everyone
highlights.description: A 400m track, covered courts and an inter-house season that every student plays in.

highlights.title: Safe journeys
highlights.description: GPS-tracked buses on fourteen routes, with a staff escort on each.

facilities: Smart classrooms for classes VI to XII
RO drinking water on every floor
